correctness.rationale: The proof splits the Mobius product exactly at the recovered prefix, shows that the corrected residual has unique lowest l-adic scale at the next prime, and then compares the true and wrong sign branches. The odd-local-prime and binary formulas follow from distinct valuations, with the (2,3) tie explicitly isolated. Exact-integer verification checks broad finite ranges at several bases and local primes.

originality.rationale: Shunia arXiv:2609.18480 gives a local least-prime extractor and obtains successive fixed-target recovery by Archimedean logarithmic peeling; it does not state the higher local prefix-residual valuation formulas here. Pomerance--Rubinstein-Salzedo provide classical Mobius-product and real-dominance background but no matching p-adic recursion. Exact and synonymous searches found no prior statement; contemporaneous unindexed work remains a residual risk.

value.rationale: The result upgrades local least-prime extraction to an exact recursive higher-prime mechanism, proves a base-independent local theorem after a recovered prefix, removes the Mobius-sign ambiguity for odd local primes, and yields a complete 2-adic recursion for odd squarefree indices.
